howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: Expected are CSV files separated by semicolons: product number; stock; active (1 or 0). The first line always counts as the header, duplicate product numbers are added up.
howTo.item2: The third column also controls visibility: a 0 sets the product inactive.
howTo.item3: Nothing is imported until Enable automatic import is switched on and the cron is running. Until then, dropped files stay where they are.
howTo.item4: With Local Directory the files belong in the folder “_act_stockimporter” in the Shopware root directory; with SFTP Server they are fetched and deleted on the server. Processed files are moved to the “backup” subfolder.
howTo.item5: The file value replaces the stock level from which Shopware has already deducted open orders. The file should therefore deliver the available quantity, not the physical stock on hand.

info.description: Automatically imports stock levels from CSV files via a local directory or SFTP, updates product stock and active status and moves processed files to a backup folder.
